frequency_question: What proportion of regulatory calendar windows see an active decision to move the countercyclical capital buffer above zero?
membership_rule: Includes all scheduled and unscheduled Federal Reserve Board policy meetings and regulatory voting periods where systemic capital buffers are formally reviewed; excludes routine microprudential bank-level examinations.
provenance_note: claimed 1 hits but 2 of 5 cases are marked hit; rate recomputed from the cases
coverage_note: 5 named major capital buffer review epochs; 1 active implementation resulting in a non-zero buffer framework.
known_gaps: Internal board deliberations and preliminary staff memos not translated into formal votes are uncounted.
skeleton: Five distinct macroprudential policy review cycles since the establishment of the modern CCyB framework, evaluated across roughly 80 FOMC/Board voting calendars.
multiplier: 1 hit resulting in active framework establishment out of multiple review opportunities over 10+ years.
validity_reason: Regulatory frameworks and voting structures for macroprudential tools remain stable over multi-year horizons unless statutory mandates change.
